component.name: Smart Downloads Organizer
component.summary: Automatically organize, categorize, and clean up your Downloads folder

description.p: Smart Downloads Organizer (SDO) is an enterprise-grade utility that watches your Downloads folder (and any other configured paths) and automatically sorts incoming files into the right locations using a fully configurable rule engine.

ul.li: Real-time file watching via Linux inotify — zero polling overhead
Automatic categorization of 200+ file extensions into 12 categories
SHA-256 duplicate detection with one-click cleanup
Configurable rule engine: match by extension, name, size, age, MIME type, or regex
Full undo history for every file operation
Cleanup suggestions for large, old, and duplicate files
Simulation (dry-run) mode to preview changes before applying
Headless mode for background operation without a GUI
Persistent SQLite database with search and filter
Dark-themed GTK3 interface designed for daily use

screenshot.caption: Dashboard showing file statistics and category breakdown
Files view with search and category filter
Rule editor for configuring automatic organization

description.p: Initial public release of Smart Downloads Organizer 2.0.

ul.li: Configurable rule engine with 8 condition operators
